description: This header file declares functions and structures related to reftable handling, particularly for setting hashes, creating a writer, and writing data to buffers. It includes external dependencies for compatibility utilities, string buffers, and reftable-writer implementations.

methods.name: cl_reftable_set_hash
methods.description: Sets the hash value for a reftable record at a specified index.

methods.name: cl_reftable_strbuf_writer
methods.description: Creates a reftable writer object that writes to a string buffer.

methods.name: cl_reftable_write_to_buf
methods.description: Writes reftable data, including references and logs, into a buffer with given options.
